learning_objective: 🎯 You will learn the magic of time travel in grammar! Discover how verbs change their form to show the past, present, and future.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Tenses show the time when an action takes place! By changing the spelling or form of a verb, we can tell if something is happening right now, has already happened, or will happen later.
We use the Present Tense to talk about things happening right now, everyday habits, or universal truths. For example, 'I play cricket' or 'The sun shines bright'.
If an action is completely finished, we use the Past Tense. We usually add '-ed' to the end of regular verbs, like turning 'play' into 'played', to show it is over!
When we talk about things that have not happened yet, we use the Future Tense. We just add the helping verbs 'will' or 'shall' before the main verb, like 'I will play tomorrow'.

fun_activity.title: ✍️ The Time Machine Diary
fun_activity.instructions: Write one sentence about what you ate for dinner yesterday (Past), one about what you are doing right now (Present), and one about what game you will play tomorrow (Future)!

quick_recap: ⭐ Tenses tell us the time of an action or event.
⭐ Present tense describes current actions, habits, or facts.
⭐ Past tense describes actions that are already completed.
⭐ Future tense describes actions that will happen later.
